title: R2W5-C1 — ingest API (mobile app client) on the QA module, 28 Oct 2026
lines: Client "QA R2W5 Client" (allowed module qa_r2w5_mod), token client_credentials -> 200, scope metadata.records.ingest
Normal create of QA Number 50 (rule: must be 10 or less)  -> 422 VALIDATION_RULE_FAILED
Normal create of Red + C (map: Red allows A, B)               -> 422 DEPENDENCY_VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED
POST /ingress/… {qa_pick: Red, qa_sub: C}                     -> 201 created, compliance_state "valid"
Record read back: QA Number = 50 stored
Also seen: "name" is dropped (dropped_fields [name]) although Name is on the layout; {} -> 201 "incomplete"
Repeated from scratch by Java R2W5SetupTest#ingestAppliesRules (fresh module, rule and map): same result
